desc:
🏕️ Survive 7 Days 🏕️

You and your friends need to survive 7 days until the help comes. 

- Keep the pilot alive
- Keep yourself alive
- Survive through: Fog, Rain, Thunder storm, Winter, Blizzard and more!

Like & Favorite the game for more updates! 

🛠️ Patch 11 Live 🛠️
- New base building
- Mining and Fishing
- New enemies Masked Stalker, Acron and new models for old enemies
- Map is upgraded, new areas more fun
